title: Have electrical work done only by licensed electrical workers
what: Have electrical work performed or supervised only by holders of an electrical work licence that authorises the work.

sources.title: Electrical Safety Act 2002 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not perform or supervise electrical work unless— (a) the person is the holder of an electrical work licence in force under this Act; and (b) the licence authorises the person to perform the work

administration.who: Regulator under the Electrical Safety Act 2002 (Qld)
